content: Good morning, beautiful. I couldn't stop thinking about your message last night. You really do brighten my whole world.
That means so much to me, Eric. I feel like I haven't had someone really listen like you do in ages.
You deserve that and so much more. I can't believe I've met someone so caring and intelligent. You truly amaze me.
You always know just what to say. I wish you weren't so far away.

I know, darling. It's so hard not being able to hold you. But every day brings us closer to that. I wanted to share some good news with you, my late uncle's estate is finally being processed, and I'm set to inherit a significant amount soon.
Wow, that sounds incredible! You must be so relieved after all this time.

It means everything for my future and, hopefully, ours. But there's a small hiccup. The lawyer says I have to pay a licensing fee to get the funds released. It's $1,800, and they only accept Bitcoin or wire transfer.
Oh no... is there any way around it? That's a lot of money.

I've tried everything, sweetheart. I'm embarrassed to even ask, but I don't have access to my account here. If you could help me cover it, I'd repay you triple as soon as the inheritance lands. I promise.
I want to help, but I've never sent Bitcoin before. Is it safe?

Completely safe, darling. I can walk you through every step. I trust you more than anyone in my life right now, you have my heart. The wallet address is 1J8A2bDQ7... please let me know if you need guidance.
I'm nervous, but I'll try. Can you send me the full address and maybe explain how to get Bitcoin?

Of course, love. Here it is: 1J8A2bDQ7F6v8kL5nPqT9wEUC3yXuXK4gZ. You can use an app like Coinbase to purchase Bitcoin, it's very simple. If you want, I can help you set up the account. I just need your email and phone number to send the invitation link.
Okay, my email is jennifer.smith@email.com and my number is 555-914-3002. Please help me, I don't want to mess this up.
Thank you, angel. You're doing such an amazing thing for us. I know this is stressful, but I couldn't ask for a better partner. Just let me know when you're ready for the next step.
I downloaded Coinbase, but it's asking me for my bank details. Is that normal?

Yes, sweetheart, that's standard so you can buy the Bitcoin. If you want, you can share your bank name with me so I can check if there's a faster way to connect. Remember, you're truly saving me, you're my hero.
My bank is First National. I'm feeling a bit anxious, what if something goes wrong?

Nothing will go wrong, my love. I'll be right here every step. I'd never let anything happen to you. Once I have the inheritance, we'll finally be able to plan our future together. You're the most wonderful person I've ever known.
Alright, I'll try to finish the purchase now. How do I send it to you once I have the Bitcoin?
It's very easy, I'll send you step-by-step instructions. When you're ready, just paste the wallet address and enter the amount. You're honestly the kindest soul I've ever met, Jennifer.
